title: Molecular Electron Microscopy for Imaging and Analysis of Soft Materials
content: Establishing techniques for atomic-level structural analysis of soft materials, such as organic and polymer materials, is essential for understanding the correlation between material structure and function and for achieving rational material design. However, in electron microscopy observation of soft materials, sample damage caused by electron beam irradiation hinders high-resolution imaging. In this study, based on a uniquely developed electron microscope sample preparation technique and high-speed electron microscopy video recording and analysis technology, we have succeeded in minimizing sample damage by the electron beam to reveal the structure of single molecules and molecular aggregates with atomic resolution. Additionally, we captured dynamic processes involving molecules, such as chemical reactions and structural transformations, in real-time video.
